headline: EU and Indonesia Sign Trade Deal, Indonesia Enters CPTPP Process
summary: The European Union and Indonesia signed a trade deal expected to lift trade by 50% in three years, while Indonesia also secured entry into the CPTPP accession process.
why: Trade agreements expand market access and tariff reductions for participating nations, altering international supply chain economics.
